'''Gharn Efflered''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] around the time of the [[Third Galactic War|galactic conflict]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] providing [[Weaponsmith|armstech]] training and items.
